name: variants_by_id
note: ProductProduct (addons/product/models/product_product.py): every variant with its template, internal reference, barcode, combination indices and active flag as the ORM reads them (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, product_tmpl_id, default_code, barcode, combination_indices, active FROM product_product ORDER BY id

name: variants_per_template
note: product.template.product_variant_count read path (_compute_product_variant_count): variants per template with the active count
source_sql: SELECT product_tmpl_id, count(*) AS variants, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_variants FROM product_product GROUP BY product_tmpl_id ORDER BY product_tmpl_id

name: orderpoints_per_variant
note: stock.warehouse.orderpoint per product (addons/stock/models/stock_orderpoint.py, embedded stockWarehouseOrderpoint[]): variants with at least one replenishment rule and their rule ids
source_sql: SELECT product_id, count(*) AS orderpoints, min(id) AS first_orderpoint_id, max(id) AS last_orderpoint_id FROM stock_warehouse_orderpoint GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY product_id

name: supplierinfo_by_id
note: ProductSupplierinfo (addons/product/models/product_supplierinfo.py): every vendor pricelist line with its vendor, template, variant, sequence and delay as the ORM reads them
source_sql: SELECT id, partner_id, product_tmpl_id, product_id, sequence, delay, company_id FROM product_supplierinfo ORDER BY id

name: supplierinfo_per_template
note: product.template.seller_ids read path (_select_seller / vendor pricelists tab): vendor lines per template and distinct vendors
source_sql: SELECT product_tmpl_id, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT partner_id) AS vendors FROM product_supplierinfo WHERE product_tmpl_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_tmpl_id ORDER BY product_tmpl_id
